```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
require(gt)
# Define the target values for A1 position
target_values <- c("NW", "N", "NE", "E", "SE", "S", "SW", "W")
```
Import trees from the GoM assessment form
need to adjust to include block id as column in tree data
And then turn function such that it reads through all spreadsheets in a folder
```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

process_excel_folder_recursive <- function(folder_path, target_values = c("NW", "N", "NE", "E", "SE", "S", "SW", "W")) {
  # Get all Excel files in the folder and subfolders
  file_list <- list.files(folder_path, pattern = "\\.xlsx$", full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)

  # Initialize an empty list to store processed data
  all_data <- list()

  # Loop through each file
  for (file_path in file_list) {
    # Read the Block_ID from the "Block info" sheet (cell B2)
    sheets <- excel_sheets(file_path)
    
    if ("Block info" %in% sheets) {
      Block_ID <- read_excel(file_path, sheet = "Block info", range = "B1", col_names = FALSE)[[1]]
    } else {
      Block_ID <- NA  # If "Block info" sheet is missing, assign NA
    }
  # Print Block_ID for each file
    cat("Processing file:", file_path, "\nBlock_ID:", Block_ID, "\n")

    # Function to check if the first cell (A1) contains a target value
    filter_sheets <- function(sheet_name) {
      first_cell <- read_excel(file_path, sheet = sheet_name, range = "A1", col_names = FALSE)
      return(!is.na(first_cell[[1]]) && first_cell[[1]] %in% target_values)
    }

    # Filter sheets based on A1 contents and remove unwanted sheets
    valid_sheets <- Filter(filter_sheets, sheets)
    valid_sheets <- valid_sheets[!valid_sheets %in% c("BlankSppAssessment")]
    # remove any sheets that begin with "Spp"
    valid_sheets <- valid_sheets[!grepl("^Spp", valid_sheets)]

    # Import valid sheets and read the desired range
    data_list <- lapply(valid_sheets, function(sheet) {
      df <- read_excel(file_path, sheet = sheet, range = "B2:F6", col_names = FALSE)
      df_long <- df %>%
        pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "column", values_to = "value") %>%
        filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
        mutate(Block_ID = Block_ID,  # Add Block_ID from "Block info" sheet
               species = sheet,  # Add sheet name
               vigour = substr(value, 1, 1),
               notes = substr(value, 2, nchar(value))) %>%
        select(Block_ID, species, vigour, notes)
      return(df_long)
    })

    # Combine data from current file and store in the list
    all_data <- append(all_data, data_list)
  }

  # Combine all processed data across multiple files and subfolders
  Trees <- bind_rows(all_data)

  # Print results
  print(Trees)

  return(Trees)
}

# Usage example
folder_path <- "./raw_data/"
Trees <- process_excel_folder_recursive(folder_path)
```
```{r}
# Count of unique Block_IDs
no_blocks_assessed <- Trees %>%
  distinct(Block_ID) %>%
  nrow()
# Count of unique Block_IDs + species
assessed <- Trees %>% mutate(vigour_value = ifelse(vigour == "P", 1, 
                                                   ifelse(vigour == "F", 2, 
                                                          ifelse(vigour == "G", 3,
                                                                 ifelse(vigour == "E", 4, 0))))) %>%
  mutate(survival = ifelse(vigour_value == 0, 0, 1)) %>%
  group_by(Block_ID, species) %>%
  summarize(count = n(), mean_vig = mean(vigour_value), survival = (sum(survival)/count), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(performance = ifelse(mean_vig >= 3.5, "Excellent", 
                              ifelse(mean_vig >= 2.5, "Good", 
                                     ifelse(mean_vig >= 1.5, "Fair", 
                                            ifelse(mean_vig >= 0.5, "Poor", 
                                                   ifelse(mean_vig < 0.5, "Fail", "Fail"))))))

# gt summary table of assessed
assessed %>%
  gt() #%>%
```
